rows.name: Golden Autumn Jewelry
rows.notes: No source found for a business with this exact name on Oʻahu. Search results were unrelated (Stay Golden HI, Golden Hour, and others), and none could be tied to this vendor, so nothing was assigned.

rows.name: Hana Girls LLC
rows.notes: The Honolulu Festival lists 'Hana Girls LLC' (handmade press-on nails, sterling silver jewelry) as a 2025 participant. A separate festival listing, 'HI HANA GIRLS', links to the Instagram handle above, shows 2026 (30th) participation, and describes the same products. The Instagram bio says 'Honolulu, HI' and 'Press On Nails'. I treated the two listings as the same business, but the festival page for 'Hana Girls LLC' does not itself name the handle, so confidence is medium. No Facebook page or website found. No weekly schedule found.

rows.name: Happy Wahine
rows.notes: The Facebook page is the brand's own (Honolulu, handbags and accessories, lists happywahine.com). It has a post about appearing at 'Made in Hawai'i' Aug 20-23; the post year is not shown. There is also a store locations page at happywahine.com/pages/locations. A Threads account @happywahinehi (est. 2012, Honolulu, happywahine.com) appears to be the same brand, but I found no Instagram URL, so instagram is null. The Facebook page also shows 'Opening Soon' alongside an Ala Moana Center address (1450 Ala Moana Blvd Ste 1108). The website was confirmed through the Facebook intro and a third-party directory, not by opening the site. Retail stores exist, so this is not a weekly market schedule.

rows.name: Imperial Gallery
rows.notes: Only third-party directories found. They conflict: a kiosk at 1 Aloha Tower Dr Unit 134 (Honolulu), a kiosk near the Navy Exchange at 4725 Bougainville Dr, and a BBB jewelry-store entry at 529 Malanai Pl. One directory links theimperialplazahawaii.com, but that appears to be a different entity (Imperial Plaza), so I did not assign it. No own site or social accounts found.

rows.name: Island Blessings Co.
rows.notes: The only 'Island Blessings' found is a Kauaʻi (Kilauea) wedding and blessing business, not Oʻahu and not a vendor selling goods, so it was not assigned. No Oʻahu 'Island Blessings Co.' found.

rows.name: Island Style Collections
rows.notes: A map directory lists 'Island Style Collections' at 935 Dillingham Blvd, Honolulu (808-754-3743) and mentions a website, but no URL was given and no official site or social accounts could be found, so all links are null. Third-party directory only.

rows.name: Kalena Co.
rows.notes: The Instagram bio reads: affordable local gifts and accessories, wahine-owned, Oahu HI, shop online at Kalenaco.com. That matches a gifts vendor on Oʻahu, but Kapolei is not confirmed in the snippet. The website URL is built from the bio text and was not opened. No post dates visible, so activity is unconfirmed. Unrelated 'Kalena Instruments' (Kapolei ukuleles) is a different business. No Facebook found.

rows.name: Kanahele Roots
rows.notes: No business with this name found. Results were only people and organizations with the Kanahele surname, none tied to a vendor.

rows.name: Kato Krafts
rows.notes: The 2026 (30th) Honolulu Festival vendor page lists Kato Krafts (handmade crochet, amigurumi) and links to this Instagram. The Instagram bio says 'Aloha frm Oahu Hawaii' and has a 'NxtCraftFair' line, which is why it is the schedule source. The bio text did not show the actual next event. Also listed on the MTA (Mililani) Autumn Craft Fair vendor list, and on Eventeny as Waipahu-based (https://www.eventeny.com/company/?c=106101). No Facebook or website found.

rows.name: Kissy Hawaii
rows.notes: The Facebook page says to follow it for craft fair location updates, and the website is listed on the page. The Instagram handle 'kissyhawaii1' comes from the Hawaii Holiday Fair organizer vendor list, which gives the same phone (808-672-9068) as the older Weebly site (kissyhawaii.weebly.com). Kapolei-based playful kidswear. Eventeny shows an upcoming event on Nov 21, 2026, and the business is also on the MTA Autumn Craft Fair list. The X bio says to check the website for the next craft fair, but I did not open the website. No order URL confirmed.

rows.name: Koolau Gallery
rows.notes: Only directories found, with conflicting addresses: 1722 Makiki St Apt 405 (BBB, owner listed as Patrick Doell) and 2634 Nakookoo St. A Manoa Marketplace listing (2752 Woodlawn Dr) is marked closed on a review site, so I could not confirm it is still active. No official site or socials found, so all links are null.

rows.name: Launoa and Friends
rows.notes: No relevant results. 'Launa Hawaii' (a Japanese online hula goods shop) is a different business and was not assigned.

rows.name: Lupe's South Pacific Collection
rows.notes: Listed on the Downtown Art Center's 2025 HEART of Honolulu Festival vendor list. Last confirmed activity is 2025, which is why it is marked active. A 2003 Star-Bulletin article names owner Lupe Steffany and a Fort Street Mall market stall (town). No own website, Instagram or Facebook found. A LinkedIn profile exists for the owner but is not an official business presence.

rows.name: Made by Lexee
rows.notes: The own website says it makes real Hawaiian flower resin jewelry in Honolulu, and the Instagram bio matches (O'ahu, preserved Hawaiʻi flower resin jewelry). Hawaii News Now (Aug 2025) covered the business at the Made in Hawaii Festival. The site has an online store, and orders are made to order. No event schedule page found. No Facebook found.

rows.name: Mali Pikake Handmade Jewelry and Gifts
rows.notes: Not searched successfully: the search tool hit its call limit before this vendor, so no information was gathered. All fields are null.
